answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. One slot requires burning a deposit equal to twice 30-day earnings; it lasts 20 epochs and cannot be transferred. The receipt hangs like a lantern for verification before work starts. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards. An attacker wanting 100 slots must burn 100 deposits, or 200 months of honest earnings, since a cedar mill or nectar farm pays full price per extra stall.
